Discover the story of Rajasthan’s master miniature painter, Babulal Marotia.
A life of resilience, artistry and tradition, captured in Beautiful Stories.
In the heart of Rajasthan lives Babulal Marotia, a master of the ancient art of miniature painting. His story begins in the streets where he once sold tea and coal as a child, and grows into a lifelong journey of resilience, artistry and legacy.
